definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines report as 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 drops the definition and reaches the same object through the RD and the REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1). Same object in both editions, so 'report file' (an FD with a REPORT clause) is the same file, and it may hold no record or constant entries; scope and evidence unchanged.
